Package implementations

Class MyDLLNode

java.lang.Object
implementations.MyDLLNode
public class MyDLLNode extends Object
A single node in a doubly linked list (DLL), used as the building block for MyDLL in CPRG 304 at SAIT.

Each node stores a String element and maintains two directional references: a predecessor (pred) pointing to the node immediately before it in the chain, and a successor (succ) pointing to the node immediately after it. A null predecessor indicates the node is the head of the list; a null successor indicates it is the tail.

Design Note – String-Specific Implementation:
This class is intentionally designed to store String elements only. A fully reusable, type-safe design would use Java generics (e.g., DLLNode<E>), allowing any object type to be stored in the node. Generic programming is outside the scope of CPRG 304 and has therefore been omitted. All element fields, parameters, and return types are fixed as String throughout this class and its usages.
